metaTitle: Custom Recycled PET Bags | Perfect Imprints
metaDescription: Order custom recycled PET bags for your brand. Eco-friendly, durable, and perfect for bulk orders at Perfect Imprints.
introHtml: Recycled PET bags are made from post-consumer plastic bottles, giving waste a second life as durable, professional-grade promotional products. For companies committed to sustainability, these bags offer a tangible way to showcase eco-conscious values without sacrificing quality. From the Arlo rPET Backpack to the Solo Re:move Duffle, each piece is built to withstand daily use while reducing environmental impact. Decorate with screen printing or embroidery for a polished, long-lasting brand impression that aligns with your green initiatives.
heroAltText: Custom recycled PET bags including backpacks, totes, and duffles made from recycled plastic bottles
